title: The OR function is not odd
statement: For every natural number $n>1$, the OR function on sign vectors of length $n$, which returns $1$ exactly when every coordinate is $1$ and returns $-1$ otherwise, is not odd; that is, it does not satisfy $f(-x)=-f(x)$ for every input $x$.
